name: Energy Assault
description: Focus pure energy into deadly melee attacks and powerful projectiles. The impact of the melee powers can often Disorient opponents, while the velocity of the ranged projectiles can send your enemies flying.

powers.name: Power Bolt
powers.description: A quick attack that rapidly hurls small bolts of energy at foes, sometimes knocking them down. Damage: Moderate, Recharge: Fast

powers.name: Bone Smasher
powers.description: This melee attack can be slow, but it compensates by dealing a good amount of damage and having a good chance to Disorient the target. Damage: High, Recharge: Moderate

powers.name: Power Blast
powers.description: A much more powerful, yet slower version of Power Bolt. Power Blast sends a focused beam of energy at a foe that can knock them back. Damage: High, Recharge: Moderate

powers.name: Explosive Blast
powers.description: You hurl a blast of charged energy that violently explodes on impact, damaging all foes near the target. Explosive Blast may knock targets backwards. Damage: Moderate, Recharge: Slow
powers.shortHelp: Ranged (Targeted AoE), Moderate DMG(Smash/Energy), Foe Knockback

powers.name: Power Build Up
powers.description: Your mastery of power and energy allows you to greatly increase the damage you deal for a few seconds, as well as slightly increasing your Accuracy  Additionally, Power Build Up greatly boosts the secondary effects of your powers. Your powers effects like Heals, Defense Buffs, Endurance Drains, Disorients, Holds, Immobilizes, Knockbacks and more, are all improved. Recharge: Long

powers.name: Whirling Hands
powers.description: By focusing your energy into the muscles in your arms, you can launch a dizzying flurry of attacks against every foe in melee range. Some foes may be hit hard enough to be Disoriented as well. Damage: Moderate, Recharge: Slow

powers.name: Total Focus
powers.description: Total Focus is complete mastery over Energy Melee. This melee attack is a very slow, but incredibly devastating attack that can knock out most opponents, leaving them Disoriented. Due to the exhausting nature of Total Focus, recharge time is very long. Damage: Extreme, Recharge: Long

powers.name: Sniper Blast
powers.description: A focused blast that can travel great distances with high Accuracy. This is a sniper attack, and is best fired from a distance, as it can be interrupted.  If you have more than 97% To-Hit, this attack becomes instant-cast. Damage: Extreme, Recharge: Slow

powers.name: Power Burst
powers.description: A devastating attack that can knock your target off their feet. Damage: Superior, Recharge: Slow
